releaseNotes:
## Guest Inbox
- Create folders and subfolders on the mail server from Guest Inbox.
- Delete custom folders with confirmation while preserving their subfolders and protecting system folders.
- Larger folder expand/collapse controls respond immediately, including for the folder currently open. Rapid clicks save the final choice correctly.
- Refresh missing folder metadata so newly created subfolders appear in the correct hierarchy.
- Move quick-reply options below the message editor. Selecting a quick reply replaces the standard signature while preserving your typed message and formatting.
